structuredContent.content:
name: runtime

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: runtime-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  runtime-evidence:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact candidate without persisted credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Read release identity and verify archive and binary before execution
        run: |
          python3 -B - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, io, json, os, pathlib, tarfile, urllib.request
          import soodles
          lock = soodles.load_lock(pathlib.Path.cwd())
          def fetch(url):
              request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'soodles-runtime-bootstrap'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=60) as response:
                  return response.read()
          api = 'https://api.github.com/repos/' + lock['repository']
          release = json.loads(fetch(api + '/releases/tags/' + lock['release']))
          commit = json.loads(fetch(api + '/commits/' + lock['release']))
          assert release['tag_name'] == lock['release']
          assert commit['sha'] == lock['commit'], 'release commit differs from lock'
          assets = [a for a in release['assets'] if a['name'] == lock['asset_name']]
          assert len(assets) == 1, 'release asset is absent or ambiguous'
          assert assets[0]['digest'] == 'sha256:' + lock['asset_sha256']
          url = 'https://github.com/' + lock['repository'] + '/releases/download/' + lock['release'] + '/' + lock['asset_name']
          archive = fetch(url)
          assert hashlib.sha256(archive).hexdigest() == lock['asset_sha256'], 'archive digest differs'
          with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
              members = [m for m in tar.getmembers() if m.name == 'noodle' and m.isfile()]
              assert len(members) == 1, 'binary member is absent or ambiguous'
              binary = tar.extractfile(members[0]).read()
          assert hashlib.sha256(binary).hexdigest() == lock['binary_sha256'], 'binary digest differs'
          directory = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'soodles-runtime'
          directory.mkdir()
          target = directory / 'noodle'
          target.write_bytes(binary)
          target.chmod(0o755)
          receipt = {'release': release['tag_name'], 'commit': commit['sha'], 'asset': assets[0]['name'],
                     'archive_sha256': lock['asset_sha256'], 'binary_sha256': lock['binary_sha256'],
                     'authorizes_landing': False}
          (directory / 'release.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
          print(json.dumps(receipt))
          PY

      - name: Canonical acceptance on the exact candidate head
        env:
          EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_HEAD"
          ./soodles acceptance verify "$RUNNER_TEMP/soodles-runtime/noodle" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/soodles-runtime/acceptance.json"
          python3 -c 'import json,sys; r=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(json.dumps({"candidate":r["candidate"],"zero_residue":r["physical"]["zero_residue"],"authorizes_landing":r["authorizes_landing"]}))' "$RUNNER_TEMP/soodles-runtime/acceptance.json"

      - name: Preserve non-authorizing evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: runtime-evidence-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/soodles-runtime/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
